title: My Brother’s Keeper
author: John H. Vandenberg
notes_text: 1.  [note_asterisk] Fast day was regularly observed throughout the Church on the first Thursday of each month until November 5, 1896, when, at a meeting of the First Presidency and the apostles, it was decided that the first Sunday of the month should be observed instead, and on Sunday, December 6, 1896, was the first time it was held on Sunday. (Andrew Jenson, Encyclopedic History of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 1941.)
